{{Short description|German inorganic chemist}}
'''Arndt Simon''' (born 14 January 1940) is a [[Germany|German]] [[inorganic chemist]].<ref name="www.haw.uni-heidelberg.de">{{Cite web|url=https://www.haw.uni-heidelberg.de/akademie/mitglied.de.html?id=192|title=HAdW Mitglied|website=www.haw.uni-heidelberg.de|access-date=2018-12-21|archive-date=2018-12-21|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181221231003/https://www.haw.uni-heidelberg.de/akademie/mitglied.de.html?id=192|url-status=dead}}</ref> He was a director at the [[Max Planck Institute for Solid State Research]] in Stuttgart.<ref name="www.leopoldina.org" />{{Infobox scientist
| name = Arndt Simon
| workplaces = [[University of Münster]],
[[Max Planck Institute for Solid State Research]] in Stuttgart
| education  = [[University of Münster]]
| doctoral_advisor = [[Harald Schäfer]]
| doctoral_students = [[Richard Dronskowski]]
| notable_students = [[Claudia Felser]]
| awards = 1972 Chemistry Award of the Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities, 1985 Wilhelm Klemm Award of the Society of German Chemists, 1987 Otto Bayer Award, 1990 Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Prize, 1998 Centenary Prize, Royal Society of Chemistry, 2004 Liebig-Denkmünze of the Society of German Chemists, 2011 Terrae Rarae Award
}}

== Life ==
Simon studied Chemistry at the [[University of Münster]] from 1960–1964.<ref name="www.leopoldina.org">{{Cite web|url=https://www.leopoldina.org/mitglieder/mitgliederverzeichnis/member/635/|title=Mitgliederverzeichnis|website=www.leopoldina.org|language=de|access-date=2018-12-21|archive-date=2018-12-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181222125410/https://www.leopoldina.org/mitglieder/mitgliederverzeichnis/member/635/|url-status=live}}</ref> He worked on his doctoral thesis in the group of [[Harald Schäfer]] from 1964–1966 and finished his habilitation in 1971.<ref name="www.leopoldina.org" /> In 1972, he was appointed as an associate professor at the [[University of Münster]].<ref name="www.leopoldina.org" /> Starting in 1974, he was a member of the Max-Planck Society and one of the directors at the [[Max Planck Institute for Solid State Research]] in Stuttgart.<ref name="www.leopoldina.org" /> Since 1975, he was an honorary professor at the [[University of Stuttgart]].<ref name="www.leopoldina.org" /> Since 2010, he has been an emeritus.<ref name="www.leopoldina.org" />

== Research ==
Simon worked on a wide range of topics in inorganic chemistry:<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.fkf.mpg.de/168586/Simon_CV.pdf|title=CV Arndt Simon|website=www.fkf.mpg.de|access-date=2018-12-21|archive-date=2019-09-16|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190916123720/https://www.fkf.mpg.de/168586/Simon_CV.pdf|url-status=live}}</ref>

* Alkali Metal Suboxides<ref name="Simon-1997">{{Cite journal|date=1997-07-01|title=Group 1 and 2 suboxides and subnitrides — Metals with atomic size holes and tunnels|journal=Coordination Chemistry Reviews|language=en|volume=163|pages=253–270|doi=10.1016/S0010-8545(97)00013-1|issn=0010-8545|last1=Simon|first1=Arndt}}</ref>
* Subnitrides of Alkaline Earth Metals<ref name="Simon-1997" />
* Metal-rich Halides and Oxides of Heavy d-Metals
* Condensed Clusters<ref name="Simon-1985">{{Cite journal|date=1985-03-15|title=Empty, filled, and condensed metal clusters|journal=Journal of Solid State Chemistry|language=en|volume=57|issue=1|pages=2–16|doi=10.1016/S0022-4596(85)80055-4|issn=0022-4596|last1=Simon|first1=Arndt |bibcode=1985JSSCh..57....2S }}</ref>
* Interstitial Atoms in Metal Clusters<ref name="Simon-1985" />
* Metalrich Binary and Ternary Halides of Lanthanides
* Thorium Cluster Compounds<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Braun|first1=Thomas P.|last2=Simon|first2=Arndt|last3=Böttcher|first3=Fred|last4=Ueno|first4=Fumio|date=1995|title=ATh12N6X29 (A  Li…Rb; X  Cl, Br): A New Type of Thorium Cluster with a Th12N6 Core|journal=Angewandte Chemie International Edition in English|volume=34|issue=5|pages=567–569|doi=10.1002/anie.199505671|issn=1521-3773}}</ref>
* Intermetallic Compounds (Pauling-Simon Rule<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Simon|first=Arndt|date=1983|title=Intermetallic Compounds and the Use of Atomic Radii in Their Description|journal=Angewandte Chemie International Edition in English|language=en|volume=22|issue=2|pages=95–113|doi=10.1002/anie.198300951|issn=1521-3773}}</ref>)
* Structures and Phase Transitions in Molecular Crystals
* Structure Property Relations (Photo Cathodes, Amorphous Metals, Magnetic Order and Frustration, Spin Crossover, Spin Glasses)
* Superconductivity<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Simon|first=Arndt|date=1997|title=Superconductivity and Chemistry|journal=Angewandte Chemie International Edition in English|language=en|volume=36|issue=17|pages=1788–1806|doi=10.1002/anie.199717881|issn=1521-3773}}</ref>
* Apparatus Development (Guinier-Simon Camera,<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Simon|first=A.|date=1970-02-01|title=Eine Tieftemperatur-Guinier-Kamera zur Untersuchung luftempfindlicher und bei Raumtemperatur flüssiger Stoffe|journal=Journal of Applied Crystallography|language=de|volume=3|issue=1|pages=18–21|doi=10.1107/S0021889870005575|bibcode=1970JApCr...3...18S |issn=0021-8898}}</ref> Area Detector Diffractometer)

== Awards ==
Simon was awarded a number of awards and honorary doctorates: 

* 1972 Chemistry Award of the [[Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities]]<ref name="www.leopoldina.org" />
* 1985 Wilhelm Klemm Award of the [[Society of German Chemists]]<ref name="www.gdch.de">{{Cite web|url=https://www.gdch.de/gdch/preise-und-auszeichnungen/gdch-preise.html|title=GDCh-Preise {{!}} Gesellschaft Deutscher Chemiker e.V.|website=www.gdch.de|language=de|access-date=2018-12-21|archive-date=2013-06-02|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130602175551/https://www.gdch.de/gdch/preise-und-auszeichnungen/gdch-preise.html|url-status=live}}</ref>
* 1987 [[Otto Bayer Award]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.bayer-stiftungen.de/de/otto-bayer-preis.aspx|title=Bayer AG – Stiftungen|last=Communications|first=Bayer AG|website=www.bayer-stiftungen.de|language=de|access-date=2018-12-21|archive-date=2018-11-05|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181105075127/http://www.bayer-stiftungen.de/de/otto-bayer-preis.aspx|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* 1990 [[Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Prize]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mpg.de/Leibniz-Preis|title=Leibniz-Preis|website=www.mpg.de|language=de|access-date=2018-12-21|archive-date=2018-12-21|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181221230647/https://www.mpg.de/Leibniz-Preis|url-status=live}}</ref> 
* 1998 Dr. rer.nat. h.c. of Technical University Dresden<ref name="www.leopoldina.org" />
* 1998 Dr. rer.nat. h.c. of University (TH) Karlsruhe<ref name="www.leopoldina.org" />
* 1998 [[Centenary Prize]], [[Royal Society of Chemistry]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.rsc.org/ScienceAndTechnology/Awards/CentenaryPrizes/PreviousWinners.asp|title=RSC Centenary Prize Previous Winners|website=www.rsc.org|access-date=2018-12-21|archive-date=2017-10-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171028215536/http://www.rsc.org/ScienceAndTechnology/Awards/CentenaryPrizes/PreviousWinners.asp|url-status=live}}</ref>
* 2001 Dr. phil. h.c. of Stockholm University<ref name="www.leopoldina.org" />
* 2002 Dr. h.c. of Université de Rennes I<ref name="www.leopoldina.org" />
* 2004 Sir Nevill Mott Lecture, [[University of Loughborough]]<ref name="www.leopoldina.org" />
* 2004 Liebig-Denkmünze of the [[Society of German Chemists]]<ref name="www.gdch.de" />
* 2011 Terrae Rarae Award<ref>{{Cite journal|last=|first=|date=2012|title=Terrae-Rarae-Preis: A. Simon; NRW-Innovationspreis: S Herres-Pawlis; Albert Einstein World Award of Science: Michael Grätzel|journal=Angewandte Chemie|volume=124|issue=19|pages=4598|doi=10.1002/ange.201202358|bibcode=2012AngCh.124.4598.|issn=1521-3757}}</ref>

He is also a member of several academies of sciences:
